options.content:
# 二级页面点击到内容可见
主口径是前台 SPA `page.navigation` 到真实内容 ready；`page.launch` 只诊断冷/直达打开。Canonical entry 由审核后的固定映射筛选，不按 URL 深度推断。P95 必须与 N、terminal/stall 同看；N<100 只作低样本观察，无数据不补 0。目标 ≤2000ms。

panels.description: 成功、前台 SPA 导航；按 route 与 Android/iOS 分列。红线为 2000ms。

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/dramas/:id|/chats|/chat/:id|/creators/:id|/wishes|/create|/creation/characters/new|/creation/data|/vip|/profile/recharge|/profile/orders|/profile/spending|/profile/messages|/profile/invite|/profile/support)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (context_route, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: Navigation ready P95（目标 ≤2000ms）

panels.description: 分子与分母来自同一批成功 page.navigation；失败、离页、stall 见终态面板。

targets.expr: sum by (context_route, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/dramas/:id|/chats|/chat/:id|/creators/:id|/wishes|/create|/creation/characters/new|/creation/data|/vip|/profile/recharge|/profile/orders|/profile/spending|/profile/messages|/profile/invite|/profile/support)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" | duration_ms <= 2000 [$__range])) / sum by (context_route, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/dramas/:id|/chats|/chat/:id|/creators/:id|/wishes|/create|/creation/characters/new|/creation/data|/vip|/profile/recharge|/profile/orders|/profile/spending|/profile/messages|/profile/invite|/profile/support)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" [$__range]))

panels.title: 2秒内 ready 占比

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/dramas/:id|/chats|/chat/:id|/creators/:id|/wishes|/create|/creation/characters/new|/creation/data|/vip|/profile/recharge|/profile/orders|/profile/spending|/profile/messages|/profile/invite|/profile/support)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: Navigation ready P95 趋势（2秒阈值）

panels.description: 每 route/platform N<100 时延长窗口，不判稳态。

targets.expr: sum by (context_route, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/dramas/:id|/chats|/chat/:id|/creators/:id|/wishes|/create|/creation/characters/new|/creation/data|/vip|/profile/recharge|/profile/orders|/profile/spending|/profile/messages|/profile/invite|/profile/support)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" [$__range]))

panels.title: 成功样本量 N

panels.description: ready/error/page_left/background 与 stalled 一起显示，避免只看成功幸存者。

targets.expr: sum by (event_name, event_data_route, event_data_tg_platform, event_data_outcome) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |~ "st_page_(terminal|stall)" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name=~"st_page_(terminal|stall)" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | event_data_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | event_data_route=~"^(/dramas/:id|/chats|/chat/:id|/creators/:id|/wishes|/create|/creation/characters/new|/creation/data|/vip|/profile/recharge|/profile/orders|/profile/spending|/profile/messages|/profile/invite|/profile/support)$" | event_data_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | event_data_route=~"^($route)$" [$__auto]))

panels.title: 终态与 stall 分母

panels.description: 文档导航起点到 ready；不与 SPA navigation P95 混算。

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_launch" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_launch" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/dramas/:id|/chats|/chat/:id|/creators/:id|/wishes|/create|/creation/characters/new|/creation/data|/vip|/profile/recharge|/profile/orders|/profile/spending|/profile/messages|/profile/invite|/profile/support)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: 辅助：冷/直达 launch P95（不进入 SPA 主口径）

title: ST 二级页面点击到内容可见（2秒目标）
